I am using our own data processing application.
Question
Apace Iceberg library offers RESTCatalog through which I am able to connect with BigLake Metastore.
There is another relatively new catalog called BigQueryMetastoreCatalog that I have not tried yet.
Which one to pick to create/update Iceberg tables for BigQuery consumption ?
The RESTCatalog has some limitations when dealing with BigQuery:

The tables created through RESTCatalog do not automatically appear in BigQuery. We need to manually create an external table in BigQuery using the metadata location.
Whenever the table's snapshot is updated, the new metadata location need to be manually updated in BigQuery.
These tables are readonly in BigQuery

The new catalog BigQueryMetastoreCatalog is supposed to address any of these limitations ?

When using remote signing with two REST Catalogs, they usually use different S3 remote signing URLs.
However currently in Iceberg, we initialize a static HTTP Client including the base_url of the signer:

      iceberg/aws/src/main/java/org/apache/iceberg/aws/s3/signer/S3V4RestSignerClient.java

           httpClient =

                   .uri(baseSignerUri())

body:
Apache Iceberg version
1.7.2
Query engine
Spark
Please describe the bug 🐞
ENV:
spark version: 3.5.2
Problem:
When deleting a namespace in spark-sql, if there are tables in it, the namespace is not deleted. However, if there are views in it, the namespace is deleted.
It seems like the namespace shouldn't be deleted if there are views.
Steps to Reproduce:
create database db1 location 's3a://test/db1';
use db1;
create table tbl1 (aaa string) location 's3a://test/db1/tbl1';
create view  view1 tblproperties('location'='s3a://test/db1/view1') as select aaa from tbl1;

drop table tbl1;
drop database db1; -- view in db1. db1 should not be deleted.

Willingness to contribute

 I can contribute a fix for this bug independently
 I would be willing to contribute a fix for this bug with guidance from the Iceberg community
 I cannot contribute a fix for this bug at this time
title: Exception raise when drop namespace, if there are views in it

body:
Query engine
Athena along with S3 table buckets (that uses Apache Iceberg internally. Not sure about exact iceberg version used)
Question
ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMNS doesn't work if table has a map column
CREATE TABLE demo_s3_table (
sale_date date,
product_category string,
sales_amount double)
PARTITIONED BY (month(sale_date))
TBLPROPERTIES ('table_type' = 'iceberg')

-- this will work
ALTER TABLE demo_s3_table
ADD COLUMNS (city string);

CREATE TABLE demo_s3_table1 (
sale_date date,
product_category string,
sales_amount double,
context MAP<STRING, STRING>)
PARTITIONED BY (month(sale_date))
TBLPROPERTIES ('table_type' = 'iceberg')

-- this won't work
ALTER TABLE demo_s3_table1
ADD COLUMNS (city string);`

Is that Athena limitation or an Apache Iceberg bug? I couldn't find any documented reason of this behavior.
title: Athena Apache Iceberg S3 table ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMNS doesn't work if table has a map column
